note: Mirrors the Tipsy Test Checklist artifact. Evidence runner: node tools/run_sheet.js [--section id]. 'Hands-on' items cannot be judged headless; list them for Sir.

sections.title: Tidewater Maritime Museum
items: The front: name on the frieze, pediment with gilded ship's wheel, EGYPT and T. REX banners, compass rose and lamps on the walk.
Entrance bay: low stone side walls with bronze handrails and lanterns, steps either side, no flat cut through the steps.
From outside, the doorway and front windows show the room, not a dark hole.
Art reads rounded and finished: fluted columns, seated kings, gold mask case, glass wall cases, benches.
At night the four lamp posts and two bronze lanterns glow with a pool of light (lantern light was halved on purpose).
Hands-on: doors slide as you drive up; room to drive round the T. rex; people give way; closing/opening times.

sections.title: Pelican Drug
items: Car park stays drawn round the store; the sliding doors fade with the walls.
Pharmacy in the corner behind the drive-through window, pickup hatch under it, PHARMACY on the wall.
From the car park you can see in through the doors and shopfront glass.
Its three car-park light masts glow at night.

sections.title: Seabreeze Trophies
items: Street door no longer stands in the doorway; spiked alley gate drops to knee height inside (known open: still looks heavy).
Engraver faces the camera at his bench; clerk at the till; one visitor browses.
Cups behind both front windows; back door and window inside.

sections.title: Stories
items: Heart run ends with Dr. Okafor meeting Tipsey face to face in the ER; no fade, no 'hours later' (hands-on).
Luna's mom comes out of a real front door at 776 Marina Way.
Every speaker's face shows; nobody snaps round when they walk away (hands-on).
Cake Run and Gus's favour only open at dusk (hands-on).

sections.title: Fleet bays and garage
items: Bays read cleanly: big vehicle full size with neighbours parked beside it, nothing overlapping.
Bay doors and pads look right by day and lit at night.
Hands-on: Fleet tab grouping, launch and send-home.

sections.title: Flying and The Lighthouse Run
items: New fleet station behind the harbour house: nothing overlapping, pads clear, a drive in, plaza back as it was (benches, flags).
At night the hangar is lit: floodlight bar over each door, edge lights round each pad; no dark seam along the house.
Rescue van's lane runs along the house front and up the new drive; three plaza flags back.
Hands-on: take-off, UP/DOWN buttons, too-tall slide, landing, the full Lighthouse Run, fog timer feel.

sections.title: Driftwood Skate Park
items: Fenced concrete park fills the cell: bowl, two quarter pipes, fun box, flat rail, pyramid, each with 3-6 m run-up; no lawn left inside.
Four skaters on boards, tilting with the slope; flood poles lit at night.
Hands-on: Tipsey rides the bowl and ramps.

sections.title: Shared rules (doors, order, cache)
items: Doors drawn sensibly: shut or parted, never half-painted or floating.
Lagoon Market Hall and Port Office sort in front of and behind things correctly.
No missing-texture boxes, no flicker, nothing painted over the wrong layer.
